# BitWave — agent index

BitWave: a bit register rendered as a wavetable. 1-8 lanes (default: three) of
`A op B -> Z`, CSV/TSV input, stepped LFO, single offline HTML file.

- Canonical app: `bitwave-v2.html` (open directly; no server, no network).
- Contract: `docs/AGENT-INTERFACE.md` (tools, envelope, deeplink, bridge, CLI, MCP).
- Onboarding: `AGENTS.md`; manifest: `agent/manifest.json`; examples: `agent/examples/`.
- Browser bridge: `window.bitwave`; hidden state: `#bitwave-state`;
  ready: `body[data-agent-ready='true']`; events: `bitwave:ready`, `bitwave:change`.
- Toolset 1.6.1; `.bitwave` schema 5 (schemas 1-4 load and upgrade). Bridge additions:
  `getDataset()` (opt-in matrix readback; `null` with no dataset),
  `setExpression(frame, text)`, `setSource(frame, source)`, `setRoute(frame, from)`,
  `record(on)`, `getLog({limit})`, `addFreeFrame(options)`, `removeFreeFrame(ref)`,
  `setFreeFrameMeta(ref, {label, sourceNote})`; state additions:
  `recording:{on,rows}`, `lanes[*].expressions`, `activeFree`, `freeFrames`,
  `lanes[*].expressionErrors`, `freeFrames[*].expressionError`.
- Dataset readback is opt-in: `getDataset()` returns
  `{columns, rows, index, kinds, widths}` (raw imported cells, leading zeros preserved;
  `kinds`/`widths` from the shared per-column typing) or `null`; read-only and synchronous,
  fresh copies, no change event. The full matrix is never in `getState()` /
  `#bitwave-state` / change payloads — their `dataset` is `{columns, rows:count, index,
  row}` (metadata plus the current row only). `setDataset({csv,index})` keeps its existing
  validation/errors and is how processed data is loaded.
- Lane range 1-8 (frames A-P and Z1-Z8), matching the shipped app cap; the default
  instrument boots with lanes 1/2/3. `setLane`/`setFrame` accept only lanes the live tree
  carries (a non-live lane is `E_OUT_OF_RANGE`, never a lane creation). The stage-bar lane
  selector is the active `select.lane-select` carrying `[data-agent-lane]`
  (`manifest.ui.laneSelect` = `#stageBar .lane-select`).
- Free Frames `F1`-`F16` (schema 5) hold standalone registers beside the lanes: same
  shared width, optional `label`/`sourceNote` provenance, CSV/expression/routing driven.
  They are the way a multi-stage pipeline (e.g. NumPy outputs) is recorded. State reports
  `activeFree` and `freeFrames` keyed by name; chains settle in one clocked tick.
- `getState().lanes` reports exactly the live lanes, keyed by the stable lane key
  (`"1"`..`"8"`, gaps allowed, ascending numeric order); state `bridge.version` is
  `1.6.1`.
- A failed expression keeps the frame's last settled bits (by design) and is reported,
  never silent: `freeFrames[*].expressionError` and `lanes[*].expressionErrors[<frame>]`
  are non-null with the evaluator message. Treat a non-null error as "this value is
  stale"; re-adding the missing frame resumes the chain. `driven` means routed only, so an
  expression source has `driven:false` plus a non-null expression.
- `.bitwave` schema 5 keys `lanes` by the stable lane key (`"1"`..`"13"`; gaps allowed,
  at most 8 lanes per document, ascending numeric order) and adds a `frames` map for free
  frames (`hex`, optional `col`/`visible`/`expression`/`label`/`sourceNote`) plus `F1`-`F16`
  route/parked endpoints; `build_deeplink` accepts schema 1-5 and always canonicalises to
  schema 5.
- `#bw=` links use the compact codec (D45/D52): base64url of a JSON array
  `[tag=5, N, view, lanes, routes, parked, dataset?, x?, frames?]` with lane tuples and omitted
  defaults; legacy JSON links still load. The 2000-char budget drops the dataset first
  (`datasetDropped`) and expressions second (`expressionsDropped`), never silently; an
  8-lane 256-bit document measures 1260 chars (`node tools/share-budget.mjs`). Share
  length is a measured metric, not a lane constraint.
- Expression sources are deterministic in the shared core: routes -> expressions -> Z;
  each expression sees the current frames plus the previous recorded row as `log.<frame>`.
  Record is a transient in-memory DAW take (not saved in `.bitwave`/links); float is a
  legitimate authoring format converted once at the boundary to exact values.
- CLI: `node agent/cli.mjs help`; MCP: `node agent/mcp-server.mjs` (stdio, zero deps).
- Pipeline handoff: `docs/PIPELINE-HANDOFF.md` + `tools/pipeline-doc.mjs` map an external
  tool's stage table (CSV) and a small pipeline spec into a schema-5 document, printing a
  capability report (width, padding, 16-frame/8-lane caps) before you compute;
  `npm run check:examples` guards the committed `examples/btc-*.bitwave.json`.
- Tools: `manifest`, `analyze_register`, `evaluate_lane`, `compare_operands`,
  `parse_dataset`, `build_deeplink`.
- Fixtures: `examples/eight-lanes.bitwave.json` (8-lane schema 4), `examples/demo.bitwave.json`.
- Machine setup: Node >= 23.6; no browser needed for CLI/MCP.
